title: Misty's Bubble Bath: the polish
kaylee: A sunnier waterfall pool, a cute muddy white bear, soft foam, soap bubbles to pop, a pink unicorn rubber duck that squeaks, and a sparkly ding as each patch comes clean.
questions: The pink unicorn rubber duck: keep it?
At the mirror Misty now just beams (no silly eyes on her or Maple anywhere in the bath). Right call?

pictures.title: The waterfall and the pool
pictures.caption: Falling water that curls over its lip, a round forest pool with ripples round her legs, a sunny morning, and splats of mud on a white bear

pictures.title: The foam
pictures.caption: Soft foam clusters with no black outlines, tan over thick mud and whitening as she scrubs; see-through rainbow soap bubbles float up to pop

pictures.title: Her tummy
pictures.caption: The sun bear's cream crescent is off (Misty is a spirit bear)

pictures.title: The whole river
pictures.caption: A winding river with pebbly banks, lily pads, pink wildflowers and sunbeams

pictures.title: The mirror
pictures.caption: She sees herself and beams with her own happy eyes
